Fig. 1. Overview of RIBR. A convolutional backbone predicts base logits and feature context. BRI estimates coordinate-conditioned logit residuals, and RRC converts detached boundary and texture cues into a residual write-back gate. The final prediction is obtained by adding the gated residual to the base logits. During training, GSBR regularizes boundary geometry and suppresses non-boundary oscillations under ultrasound speckle.
